Alex Baena.note: Baena has given Spain left-side delivery and a goal against Uruguay. His best moments come when the defense expects another pass and he plays the sharper one.
Alex Baena.noteZh: 巴埃纳给西班牙提供左侧传递，也在对乌拉圭时进球。他最好的时刻，是防线以为还会横传时，他送出更尖锐的一脚。

Alex Grimaldo.note: Grimaldo is Spain's luxury left-footed service option. If the match needs cleaner delivery from deeper areas, he changes the crossing angle immediately.
Alex Grimaldo.noteZh: 格里马尔多是西班牙奢侈的左脚传中选择。如果比赛需要从更深位置送出更干净的传球，他会立刻改变传中角度。

Aymeric Laporte.note: Laporte keeps Spain's back line comfortable on the ball. His assist against Saudi Arabia showed how his passing can skip the safe option and find the scorer.
Aymeric Laporte.noteZh: 拉波尔特让西班牙后防在有球时更舒服。他对沙特的助攻说明，他的传球可以跳过安全选项，直接找到得分手。

Borja Iglesias.note: Borja is Spain's more traditional penalty-area body. He matters if the match gets crowded and Spain need someone to hold off centre-backs instead of only combining around them.
Borja Iglesias.noteZh: 博尔哈是西班牙更传统的禁区身体点。如果比赛变得拥挤，西班牙需要有人顶住中卫，而不只是围着他们配合，他就有价值。

Dani Olmo.note: Olmo is Spain's attacker for the pocket between midfield and defense. His assist against Saudi Arabia came from arriving in the right space before the back line adjusted.
Dani Olmo.noteZh: 奥尔莫是西班牙在中场和防线之间找空当的攻击手。他对沙特的助攻来自在后防调整前先到正确位置。

David Raya.note: Raya is the goalkeeper who keeps Spain's first pass clean if Unai Simon is not used. His value is making pressure look like another passing drill.
David Raya.noteZh: 如果西蒙不出场，拉亚是能让西班牙第一脚出球保持干净的门将。他的价值是把压力处理得像一次普通传球练习。

Eric Garcia.summary: Eric García is a Spain centre-back from Barcelona who gives the national team build-up passing, tactical coverage, and calm defending.
Eric Garcia.note: Eric Garcia is defensive cover for a Spain side that wants centre-backs to pass, not only defend. He is there when the buildup needs another calm angle.
Eric Garcia.noteZh: 埃里克·加西亚是西班牙的防守深度，这支球队希望中卫不只是防守，也要传球。当后场组织需要另一个冷静角度时，他有价值。

Fabian Ruiz.note: Fabian gives Spain another left-footed controller when the midfield needs patience. He slows the game, then changes the lane before pressure arrives.
Fabian Ruiz.noteZh: 法比安在中场需要耐心时，给西班牙另一名左脚控制者。他先放慢比赛，再在压力到来前改变线路。

Ferran Torres.note: Ferran has already made a late winner happen with the assist against Portugal. He is the wide forward who keeps attacking the scoring lane after the move looks finished.
Ferran Torres.noteZh: 费兰已经用对葡萄牙的助攻制造了后段绝杀。他是那种在进攻看似结束后，仍继续冲击得分线路的边锋。

Gavi.note: Gavi is Spain's pressure switch. If the match gets sleepy, he brings tackles, short combinations, and the kind of edge that makes possession feel alive again.
Gavi.noteZh: 加维是西班牙的压迫开关。如果比赛变得沉闷，他会带来抢断、短传配合，以及让控球重新有生命力的锋芒。

Joan Garcia.note: Joan Garcia is the high-upside goalkeeper depth. For this tournament card, he is insurance behind the keepers Spain trust to play short.
Joan Garcia.noteZh: 霍安·加西亚是上限很高的门将深度。在这届世界杯的卡片里，他是西班牙短传门将身后的保险。

Lamine Yamal.note: Yamal is Spain's player who makes a settled defense pause. He scored early against Saudi Arabia, but the bigger story is how his first touch creates time for Pedri and Oyarzabal.
Lamine Yamal.noteZh: 亚马尔是西班牙让站稳防线停顿的人。他对沙特早早进球，但更大的故事是他的第一下触球如何为佩德里和奥亚萨瓦尔创造时间。

Marc Cucurella.note: Cucurella has turned left-back into a source of chances, assisting Oyarzabal twice against Austria. He presses hard, then still appears with the final pass.
Marc Cucurella.noteZh: 库库雷利亚把左后卫变成了机会来源，对奥地利两次助攻奥亚萨瓦尔。他压迫很凶，却仍会出现在最后一传的位置。

Marc Pubill.note: Pubill gives Spain a taller right-back profile. He is the choice if the flank needs more size without giving up the option to overlap.
Marc Pubill.noteZh: 普比尔给西班牙提供更高大的右后卫类型。如果边路需要更多身高，同时仍保留套边选择，他就有意义。

Marcos Llorente.note: Llorente is Spain's vertical utility piece. His assist against Uruguay fit the role: run beyond the neat passing and make the attack arrive faster.
Marcos Llorente.noteZh: 略伦特是西班牙的纵向多面手。他对乌拉圭的助攻正符合这个角色：跑到精细传递之外，让进攻更快到达。

Martin Zubimendi.note: Zubimendi is the calm spare hinge behind Rodri. If Spain need control without changing the whole idea, he keeps the first pass simple.
Martin Zubimendi.noteZh: 祖比门迪是罗德里身后的冷静备用枢纽。如果西班牙需要控制但不想改变整体思路，他会让第一脚传球保持简单。

Mikel Merino.note: Merino owns Spain's biggest knockout moment so far, the 90+1 winner against Portugal. His game is timing: arrive late, make contact, leave no time to answer.
Mikel Merino.noteZh: 梅里诺拥有西班牙目前最大的淘汰赛时刻，对葡萄牙90+1分钟绝杀。他的比赛关键词是时机：后插上、完成触球、不给对手回应时间。

Mikel Oyarzabal.note: Oyarzabal has been Spain's cleanest finisher in this run. He does not need the move to be loud, just one defender half a step late.
Mikel Oyarzabal.noteZh: 奥亚萨瓦尔是西班牙这段征程中最干净的终结者。他不需要进攻声势很大，只需要防守者慢半步。

Nico Williams.note: Nico gives Spain the threat that keeps the far side honest. Even when he is not scoring, his speed stops teams from squeezing everything toward Yamal.
Nico Williams.noteZh: 尼科给西班牙带来让远端防线不敢收得太狠的威胁。即使他没有进球，他的速度也会阻止对手把一切都压向亚马尔。

Pau Cubarsi.note: Cubarsi lets Spain keep passing from the back even under pressure. He is young, but the point is how early he sees the forward lane.
Pau Cubarsi.noteZh: 库巴西让西班牙在压力下仍能从后场传出球。他很年轻，但关键在于他很早就能看见向前线路。

Pedri.note: Pedri is the player who makes Spain's possession feel less sterile. He receives under pressure, turns the ball into a better angle, and lets the wide players attack later.
Pedri.noteZh: 佩德里让西班牙的控球不只是空转。他能在压力下接球，把球转到更好的角度，再让边路球员发动。

Pedro Porro.note: Porro has given Spain a scoring right-back in this run. Against Austria, he arrived high enough to finish, not just serve from deep.
Pedro Porro.noteZh: 波罗在这段征程中给西班牙带来能进球的右后卫。对奥地利时，他前插到足够高的位置完成终结，而不只是从深处传球。

Rodri.note: Rodri is Spain's safety net and traffic controller. When Yamal and the wide players stretch the match, he decides whether Spain speed up or lock it down.
Rodri.noteZh: 罗德里是西班牙的安全网和交通指挥。当亚马尔和边路球员把比赛拉开时，他决定西班牙是加速还是收住。

Unai Simon.note: Unai Simon has been Spain's tournament goalkeeper through the knockout run. His job is to defend space early enough that Spain can keep the back line brave.
Unai Simon.noteZh: 乌奈·西蒙是西班牙淘汰赛阶段的门将。他的任务是尽早处理身后空间，让西班牙防线继续保持勇敢。

Victor Munoz.note: Munoz is a fresh-speed option for Spain's front line. He is there for matches that need one more sprint behind a tired defender.
Victor Munoz.noteZh: 穆尼奥斯是西班牙锋线的新鲜速度选择。当比赛需要再冲一次疲劳防守者身后时，他就有意义。

Yeremy Pino.note: Yeremy is a work-rate winger for Spain's bench. He presses first, then slips inside when the possession chain needs another quick combination.
Yeremy Pino.noteZh: 耶雷米是西班牙替补席上的高跑动边锋。他先压迫，再在控球链条需要快速配合时内收。
